concept: Потребность / мечта: старатель мечтает разбогатеть — от первого самородка в лотке до дилижанса, гружёного золотом.

cards.label: Nugget
cards.key_features: an irregular lumpy rounded shape with soft bumps, rich warm gold
cards.pose: The nugget is turned diagonally, seen slightly from above

cards.label: Panning
cards.object: wide shallow gold pan with a little river water
cards.surface: smooth rounded river pebbles that cover the whole ground all the way to the bottom edge of the frame
cards.scene: gold pan resting on a bed of river pebbles; pebbles fill the entire lower part of the image, no strip of plain backdrop below them
cards.story_detail: a few shiny gold flakes and a small nugget in the water
cards.key_features: a round shallow pan with sloped sides, clear water inside, gold flakes visible at the bottom
cards.pose: We look down at the pan at about 40 degrees so the gold inside is clearly visible

cards.label: Pickaxe
cards.object_color: red-painted head and light wooden handle
cards.key_features: a curved double-pointed head mounted crosswise on a long straight handle
cards.pose: The pickaxe is rotated diagonally, handle toward the lower left, head at the upper right

cards.label: Lantern
cards.key_features: a glass chimney with wire guards, a round brass base, a carrying handle on top

cards.label: Lucky Sack
cards.object: plump burlap sack tied with a rope
cards.story_detail: shiny gold coins spilling out of its open top onto the floor
cards.key_features: rough woven burlap texture, a rope tie at the neck, plain gold coins with no symbols
cards.pose: The sack sits slightly tilted in 3/4 view, coins pouring toward the viewer

cards.label: Pocket Watch
cards.object: pocket watch with an open lid and a short chain
cards.key_features: a round case with an open hinged lid, a cream white face with simple dots instead of numbers, two hands, a winding crown with a chain
cards.pose: The watch is tilted diagonally, chain curling toward the lower left

cards.label: Assay Scale
cards.story_detail: a sparkling gold nugget in one pan outweighing the other
cards.detail_color: bright sunny yellow gold, clearly lighter and yellower than the copper scale
cards.key_features: a central post with a horizontal beam and two hanging round pans, one pan lower than the other
cards.pose: Eye-level frontal 3/4 view, the heavier pan on the left; the whole scale including both pans fits inside the central 70% of the image width, with empty backdrop on both sides

cards.label: Camp
cards.object_color: creamy white canvas with an orange flap
cards.scene: a sparkling turquoise river and green pine trees
cards.story_detail: a small campfire with a coffee pot in front
cards.key_features: an A-frame tent with an open front flap, wooden poles and ropes
cards.pose: Low camera close to the campfire, the tent rising behind it in 3/4 view

cards.label: Mine Cart
cards.object: wooden mine cart heaped with gold nuggets
cards.scene: a simple bright scene: a timber-framed mine entrance in an orange rock cliff on the right side of the frame, clear blue sky above the cart
cards.story_detail: a heap of glittering gold nuggets
cards.key_features: a box-shaped cart on four small flanged wheels; the cart stands squarely ON the track: each wheel rests exactly on top of a rail, left wheels on the left rail and right wheels on the right rail, the cart aligned with the direction of the rails; rails curve out of the mine entrance
cards.pose: The rails come out of the mine entrance on the right and curve toward the viewer; the cart rolls out along them, big in the foreground and centered. The mine entrance and rocks are shifted to the right and stay behind the cart, so the cart's path out of the tunnel is clearly visible; the heap of gold is seen against the clear blue sky, not against the rocks. Keep the background simple and uncluttered

cards.label: Gold Coach
cards.object_color: bright red with sunny yellow wheels
cards.scene: a sandy desert road with small cacti
cards.story_detail: an open treasure chest full of gold on the roof
cards.key_features: a rounded coach body with a door and window, big spoked wheels, a driver's bench at the front, no horses
cards.pose: Low-angle 3/4 view from the front corner, the wheels big in the foreground
